title: Decisions

  them

---

The brief lists the decisions that belong to a human: physics modelling choices, licence and
data questions, which properties to prove, use of the compute cluster, and benchmark failures
that aren't explained by a bug. When the agent reaches one, it writes the question down with
context and a recommended answer, carries on with whatever isn't blocked, and waits. Numbers
(OQ-*n*) match the project's internal record. Newest first within each group.

## Awaiting a decision

### OQ-11 · A second ASCOT5 cluster job {#oq-11}

The first ASCOT5 job ([entry 10](log/10-ascot5-alpha-heating.qmd)) showed that the orbit
tolerance chosen for speed loses alphas that should be confined ([C-043](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-043)), and that at the
tighter tolerance 640 markers resolve the total alpha heating but not its radial shape ([C-045](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-045)).
Open: a second job, one node for up to four hours, with ten times more markers at the tighter
tolerance and a check at a tighter one still. *Recommendation:* approve it, so the ASCOT5
source is converged before M1 counts it as done.

### OQ-1 · The toy transport model as a fallback {#oq-1}

M0 needed a toy transport model to exercise the loop; the brief didn't specify one. A smooth
critical-gradient form was used as a numerical placeholder, not a physics claim. Open: whether
the trusted fallback for real runs should be that, a constant diffusivity, or the
Bohm/gyro-Bohm form now used as the fallback inside TORAX. *Recommendation:* decide at the M1
physicist review together with the pedestal and sawtooth choices.

## Settled

### OQ-10 · Which radial variable the guard's features use {#oq-10}

*Deferred 1 Oct 2026, to M3.* The guard checks whether a plasma state is inside the region the
surrogate was trained on, using features such as normalised temperature gradients. toktoit
computes those gradients with respect to the normalised flux radius, scaled by the geometric
minor radius; QLKNN, as TORAX feeds it, uses the midplane minor radius of each surface. On the
ITER hybrid scenario the two differ from [+19%]{.claim}[C-032](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-032){.cid .st-measured} in the core to about a third at the
edge ([K-008](/Blog/toktoit/ceilings.qmd#k-008)). No run is affected yet. **The convention will be chosen when the first trained
surrogate exists (M3)**, and in any case before a verified domain is certified (M4).

### OQ-9 · Fast-ion sources from ASCOT5 {#oq-9}

*Decided 1 Oct 2026.* **Fusion alphas first**, born from the plasma profiles TORAX computes, as
a direct check against TORAX's own alpha heating. Neutral-beam ions follow once a physicist has
approved the injector geometry. **One short test job on the compute cluster is approved**; each
further job needs its own approval.

### OQ-5 · What "reproduces the benchmark" means {#oq-5}

*Decided 1 Oct 2026.* Two comparisons: toktoit's loop against TORAX's own output at the same
settings (a check of the wrapper), and against the published cross-code comparison (a physics
statement). **The wrapper check must agree to 10^-10^** (it passes at round-off: [C-006](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-006), [C-007](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-007)).
**The physics tolerance is set by the physicist reviewer** at the M1 gate. Because the published
reference runs are not converged in time ([entry 3](log/03-fixed-step-loop.qmd), [C-012](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-012), [C-013](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-013)),
**the physics comparison is made at the published settings first**, then at a converged time
step, with the difference reported as its own line in the discrepancy budget. **Solver stalls
stay reported**, not tuned away by relaxing a line-search setting
([entry 5](log/05-stalls-rf-and-builds.qmd), [C-011](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-011)). **Energy and particles must balance to
10^-6^ per step** on converged steps ([entry 8](log/08-energy-particle-balance.qmd), [C-035](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-035), [C-036](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-036)); the
flat-top reference solver's defect ([C-037](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-037)) is reported, not required to close.

### OQ-3 · Where the code will live {#oq-3}

*Decided 1 Oct 2026.* **A private hosted repository**, where the continuous-integration
workflow runs on every change. The code stays private; this log is how the work is shown. Until
the workflow has passed, "tested" in the [claims register](claims.qmd) still means "asserted by
a named test, run before each publish".

### OQ-8 · Which machine description for the equilibrium solver {#oq-8}

*Decided 30 Sep 2026.* **MAST-U.** FreeGSNKE's repository already ships a MAST-U-like machine
description (coils, passive structures, limiter, wall; credited to UKAEA) under the same open
licence, so nothing had to be assembled from published drawings. It is fetched from a pinned
upstream version with a checksum per file. This covers the equilibrium work only: the M1
transport benchmark stays with the ITER scenario, because no published TORAX MAST-U scenario
exists and QLKNN was not trained on spherical-tokamak conditions.

### OQ-7 · Input data for a STEP extension {#oq-7}

*Deferred 30 Sep 2026.* Extending the benchmark to a STEP power-plant flat-top is a future
extension, not part of M1. The work stays with the ITER benchmark and MAST-U for now; the data
question reopens if and when the extension is picked up.

### OQ-6 · Which benchmark {#oq-6}

*Decided 21 Sep 2026, amended 30 Sep 2026.* **The ITER hybrid scenario** that ships with
TORAX: an 80-second current ramp-up, and a 5-second flat-top as the quicker check. A planned
STEP extension was deferred on 30 Sep ([OQ-7](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-7)).

### OQ-4 · Newton-Raphson for the coupling loop {#oq-4}

*Decided 21 Sep 2026.* **Approved.** The M0 loop used relaxed Picard iteration, which
oscillates instead of converging once transport becomes stiff: on the toy model's original
settings the residual sat between 3 × 10⁻² and 8 × 10⁻² after 12 iterations. The owner
approved a Newton-Raphson solver with derivatives from automatic differentiation and a fixed
iteration count, keeping Picard as the fallback, and stall reporting for both
([entry 1](log/01-newton-solver.qmd)).

### OQ-2 · Where to run {#oq-2}

*Decided 21 Sep 2026.* Tests and the early milestones run on an interactive node with one
datacentre GPU. Anything longer goes through the cluster's batch system on an allocation the
owner named, and every job is announced to the owner before it is submitted.
